_comment: Shared proof points used across many pages. Change a number here and every page that shows it updates.

process.title: Strategy and architecture
process.body: We validate the idea against governor limits and design a data model that holds from ten users to ten thousand.

process.title: Development in LWC and Apex
process.body: Native builds, reviewed in pull requests, deployed through a scratch-org pipeline you keep after we leave.

process.title: Security Review
process.body: We prepare the package, run the scanner, write the responses and stay on the ticket until it passes.

process.title: Packaging and listing
process.body: Managed package versioning, listing copy, demo org and the assets the AppExchange team asks for.
